anomalies.description: A white SUV in the center lane collides with a dark vehicle ahead and to its right, causing visible impact and abrupt deceleration; the collision is captured across frames f3–f5.

Following the initial impact, the white SUV appears to be pushed sideways or loses control, resulting in a secondary contact with the large truck on the right (visible in f4–f6), generating significant dust/debris and obscuring view.

A silver SUV in the left lane abruptly swerves right across the solid white line, colliding with or nearly colliding with the recording vehicle (red hood visible). The SUV’s front end turns sharply toward the camera vehicle, indicating a loss of control or intentional maneuver resulting in a crash or near-miss.
